evidence: Liv. 3.51: sē in ōrdinem cōgī (Lewis & Short s.v. ōrdō)
terms.comment: Literally “force back into the ranks”; Traupman gives it for “bring (a meeting) to order”, which is not its classical sense.

sources: Lewis & Short: ordo
Lewis & Short: cogo
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 178.
Quotations marked “Lewis & Short” are given as Lewis & Short cites them, in the house spelling; they have not been checked against a modern edition.
